n91944.source: Xenophon, Memorabilia, ed. Edgar Carew Marchant, 1921 (Perseus)

n91944.source: Herodotus, Historiae, ed. A. D. Godley, Cambridge 1920 (Perseus)

n91944.source: Herodotus, Historiae, ed. A. D. Godley, Cambridge 1920 (Perseus)

n91944.source: Thucydides, Historiae, ed. Henry Stuart Jones, Oxford 1910 (Perseus)

n91944.source: Xenophon, Memorabilia, ed. Edgar Carew Marchant, 1921 (Perseus)

n91944.source: Plato, Leges, ed. John Burnet, Oxford 1915 (Perseus)
